answer: In PoA, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so each identity must deliver sustained honest service to preserve influence. Reciprocity-weighted trust edges are normalized through EigenTrust matrix factorization; freshly spawned sybil identities therefore have near-zero eigenvector centrality and, lacking established trusted paths, cannot move the network past consensus thresholds, whether traffic traverses a delta, wharf, or timber relay.
